fn merge_sorted(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires sorted(xs) and sorted(ys)
  ensures sorted(result) and len(result) == len(xs) + len(ys)
  ensures forall x in xs: contains(result, x)
  ensures forall x in ys: contains(result, x)
  effects pure
  example merge_sorted([1, 4, 9], [2, 3]) == [1, 2, 3, 4, 9]
  example merge_sorted([], [5, 6]) == [5, 6]
  example merge_sorted([1, 2], []) == [1, 2]
  example merge_sorted([], []) == []
{
  match xs {
    [] => ys
    [x, ..xs_rest] =>
      match ys {
        [] => xs
        [y, ..ys_rest] =>
          if x <= y then
            [x] ++ merge_sorted(xs_rest, ys)
          else
            [y] ++ merge_sorted(xs, ys_rest)
      }
  }
}

fn power(base: Int, exp: Int) -> Int
  requires exp >= 1
  ensures exp == 1 and result == base or exp > 1 and result == base * power(base, exp - 1)

  example power(5, 1) == 5
{
  if exp == 1 then
    base
  else

}

fn take(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires k >= 0 and k <= len(xs)
  ensures len(result) == k
  effects pure
  example take([1, 2, 3, 4], 0) == []
  example take([1, 2, 3, 4], 2) == [1, 2]
  example take([1, 2, 3, 4], 4) == [1, 2, 3, 4]
  example take([], 0) == []
{
  if k == 0 then [] else
    match xs {
      [] => []
      [h, ..t] => [h] ++ take(t, k - 1)
    }
}

fn rotate_left(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires k >= 0 and k <= len(xs)
  ensures len(result) == len(xs)
  ensures forall x in xs: count(result, x) == count(xs, x)

  example rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 4) == [1, 2, 3, 4]
  example rotate_left([1], 0) == [1]
  example rotate_left([1], 1) == [1]
  example rotate_left([], 0) == []
{
  drop(xs, k) ++ take(xs, k)
}
